title: Create all data for a topline — topline_freqs
text: Use topline_freqs() automate quantitative frequencies topline report. function works best questions proper prefixes: "s_" single select, "m_" multiple select, "oe_" open ends, "n_" numeric, "r_" ranked, "md_" max diff.

title: Create all data for a topline — topline_freqs

title: Create all data for a topline — topline_freqs
text: dataset dataframe want create topline weight_var Variable containing weights assign_s DEFAULT = NULL, vector unquoted variables treated single select variables, put within c() assign_m DEFAULT = NULL, vector unquoted variables treated multiple select variables, put within c() assign_n DEFAULT = NULL, vector unquoted variables treated numeric variables, put within c() unweighted_ns DEFAULT = TRUE, Display weighted unweighted n-sizes topline report silently DEFAULT = FALSE, Hide message output (e.g., progress completing freqs variables printing variables included topline)
